strings.1、本游戏是一款玩法简单的角色养成类游戏，适用于年满12周岁及以上的用户，建议未: 1. This is a simple character-raising game for players aged 12 and up. Minors should play under a parent's supervision.
strings.2、本游戏基于架空的故事背景，剧情简单且积极向上，部分人物有区别于现实场景的适度: 2. The game is set in a fictional world with a simple, upbeat story. Some characters are freely adapted and won't be mistaken for reality. Players build strong parties and clear quests to help a hero turned beast return to his world and defeat the Demon Lord. There is no text or voice chat with strangers.
strings.3、本游戏已接入国家实名认证系统，未实名认证用户将无法登录游戏进行任何的游戏体验: 3. The game uses real-name verification; unverified players can't log in. Some content and items are paid. Verified minors may only play from 20:00 to 21:00 on Fridays, Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays. Since September 1, 2021, minors can't register; players under 16 can't make purchases; players aged 16-17 may spend at most 50 CNY per purchase and 200 CNY per month.
strings.4、本游戏以弹珠台战斗为主题，玩家通过将不同类型的角色组合来实现强大的技能合击效: 4. Battles are pinball-style: combine different characters for powerful skill combos against all kinds of strong enemies, which builds strategic thinking. A few team quests need players to cooperate, which builds teamwork. The unique art style, detailed character illustrations and well-made pixel scenes offer a beautiful visual experience.
